header: The import tool saves what it read from the pages (health-cache/) so that --apply does not read them again. A saved reading is only good if the reader that made it is the reader that is running now. A version number someone must remember to bump is not good enough (a changed row filter was once NOT picked up and the old reading, with its wrong row, was reused). So I tie the saved reading to a fingerprint of the reader's own source files: change any of them and every saved reading is read again.

symbols.name: extractorFingerprint
doc: I take the SHA-1 of the reader's source files in `dir` (the self-tests are not part of the reader). It is stable for the same code and different for any change.
